why: aws-iam-authenticator authentication failures (access denied, unable to authenticate). Expired tokens, wrong role mappings, brute-force attempts
query: fields @timestamp, @message | filter @logStream like /authenticator-/ and (@message like /access denied/ or @message like /Unable to authenticate/ or @message like /invalid/ or @message like /error/) | parse @message /msg="(?<msg>[^"]{0,80})/ | stats count() as c by msg | sort c desc | limit 15
